csv_scope_of_work: The City of Stone Mountain, Georgia is seeking Request for Qualifications from engineering firms to perform on-call Architecture, Engineering, Surveying services. The consultant shall have the ability to provide in-house services, or the capacity to sublet services including but not limited to construction inspections and certifications, general engineering, surveying, GIS services, hydrology study review, public storm water, public streets, public sanitary sewer system, and all aspects of the City water and wastewater system.

title: On-Call Professional Architecture, Engineering and Surveying Services
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary municipal engineering and surveying services for the City of Stone Mountain.
project_scope: On-call professional services for municipal infrastructure and related architecture/engineering tasks in the City of Stone Mountain. Scope includes construction inspections and certifications, general engineering, surveying, GIS services, hydrology study review, public stormwater, public streets, public sanitary sewer systems, and all aspects of the city's water and wastewater system. Requested disciplines include architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, environmental engineering/planning/design, hydrology/hydraulics, wastewater treatment engineering, traffic design engineering, and transportation planning. No specific structure, span, floor area, or defined project size is stated.
services: On-call architecture, engineering, and surveying services; civil engineering; landscape architecture; geotechnical engineering; surveying/GIS/mapping; environmental engineering/planning/design; hydrology/hydraulics; wastewater treatment engineering; traffic design engineering; transportation planning; construction inspections and certifications.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call services without a defined technically specific structure.
